- Deployment options (VPC/on-prem summary)

- Security/compliance highlights (SOC2, KMS)

Thanks — Claire

Hi Claire — thanks for sending the itinerary and context. 30 minutes is absolutely doable. Two quick options so we can accommodate your travel gaps:

Option A — Live compact demo (30 min): 08:00–08:30 PT on Aug 14. We’ll prioritize deployment patterns + security notes and leave 10 minutes for Q&A.
Option B — Full demo (60 min) later in the morning if you can free up time on-site; otherwise we can send a short recorded walkthrough (10–15 min) and do a 15–20 min live Q&A at a time that suits you.

I’m looping in Marissa (onsite lead) to confirm if we can do the early slot in-person / hybrid and to record the condensed walkthrough. I’ve attached our demo deck that maps to the agenda in case your team wants to skim before the session.

If Aug 14 at 08:00 PT works, I’ll put a tentative hold on the calendar and confirm logistics (room/AV or Zoom).

Best,
